approach: vectorbt 1.1.0 zero-cost reference convention (fee=0, slip=0 -> 0bp rt) applied to the in-house entry/exit schedule; equity walk is risk_per_trade-scaled bar MTM (equity *= (1 + scale * bar_ret)) on real 1h closes, cost amortised over held bars; validated by reproducing the in-house equity CSV at in-house cost. Sharpe uses the in-house formula (mean/std of per-trade pnl x sqrt(trades/yr)).
